portalHost.description: The portal host to use when constructing urls.

guideDocBatchOptions.description:
The batch options to use for the {@link GuideDocExport} batch job that parallelizes the export
of guide `c3doc.md` files.
Specifies the batch size and timeout duration for each guide export operation.

topicDocBatchOptions.description:
The batch options to use for the {@link TopicDocExport} batch job that parallelizes the export
of topic `c3doc.md` files.
Specifies the batch size and timeout duration for each topic export operation.

typeDocBatchOptions.description:
The batch options to use for the {@link TypeDocExport} batch job that parallelizes the export
of `.c3typ` files.
Specifies the batch size and timeout duration for each type export operation.

includePlatformDocumentation.description: If true, implicitly include all packages with a missing version which implies that the package belongs to the platform.

packagesToInclude.description:
The packages to include in the documentation generation. Only these packages will be included in documentation
generation, if specified.

packagesToExclude.description: The packages to exclude in the documentation generation. This configuration takes precedence over #packagesToInclude.

packageVersionsToInclude.description:
The packages to include in the documentation generation, along with their versions. This takes precedence over
both #packagesToInclude and #packagesToExclude.

WARNING!
- THIS IS ONLY FOR TESTING THE OUTPUT DETERMINISTICALLY. SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR PRODUCTION ARTIFACT GENERATION!
- The package versions are set as-is, i.e, not trimmed down to `major.minor` as they are when run without this
  spec.
